text: Never publish a short video as private first. The recommendation system will not test the thumbnail or the title while it stays hidden.
Changing the title of a dead short did not revive it. The first impression is spent on the original packaging.
The bridge from short videos to long-form videos works when the short promises a specific payoff the long video actually delivers.
Lessons about making short videos: hook in the first second, readable title, and never burn the first public impression on a private upload.
A garden journal notes that tomatoes prefer consistent watering and afternoon shade in late summer.
